subject: Request: Sponsored isolated-eval credits for regulated pilot (Novamed)
messages:
From: Alex Tan <alex.tan@novamed.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@novamed.io
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Isolated/VPC pilot — need sponsored credits for air-gapped eval

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile but we hit a roadblock with our regulator. For our upcoming pilot we must run an air-gapped evaluation inside our EU-controlled VPC and also produce an evidence bundle (questionnaire + log retention plan).

Two asks: can Redwood provide a sponsored credit allowance specifically for an isolated private evaluation (no egress) so we can complete the tests? Second, can you share the SOC2/pen test artifacts and a short note on how audit logs for Private deployments are stored and exported?

Attached is our vendor security questionnaire (filled high-level) — you'll see timelines: we need the exec summary and access to a seeded environment by Sep 8 to hit our board window.

Appreciate help — this pilot unlocks a multi-cluster procurement for us.

— Alex
Alex Tan
Head of Cloud & Security, Novamed Health
phone: +44 20 7946 0123

Attachments: novamed-security-questionnaire.pdf
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Tan <alex.tan@novamed.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolated/VPC pilot — need sponsored credits for air-gapped eval

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. I looped in Ben (sales ops) and Karthik (security/solutions) to scope what we can sponsor and what evidence we can provide for a Private VPC evaluation.

Quick commitments:
- Ben: can you confirm a sponsored credit bucket (amount + duration) we can allocate for an isolated POC?
- Karthik: can your team compile the SOC2 summary + the Private audit-log export steps (EU region) and confirm we can provide an environment with egress disabled?

If we can get those items by end of week we should be able to meet Nov 8 delivery.

I’ll also prepare a short amendment (DocuSign) to attach to the trial terms so Novamed’s procurement has the approved credit/usage scope.

Thanks,
Lauren
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolated/VPC pilot — need sponsored credits for air-gapped eval

On Sun, Aug 30, 2026 at 11:03 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire.

Lauren — can do on sponsored credits. Proposal: $12k credits scoped to the Private (VPC) pilot, valid for 45 days from environment activation; credits only redeemable for the pinned model variants used in the pilot and require completion of the vendor questionnaire and a signed PO amendment.

Rationale: sized to cover a 4-6 week isolated eval with medium token volume and modest embedding calls. If Security requires longer retention on logs we can discuss a one-time top-up.

I’ll draft the amendment (DocuSign) and attach it. Does that align with Novamed’s board timing?

— Ben
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolated/VPC pilot — need sponsored credits for air-gapped eval

Ben / Lauren — short security note for Novamed: we can produce a SOC 2 summary, pen test high-level findings, and an audit-log export plan for Private deployments in the EU region. For air-gapped evaluations we operate in a customer-managed VPC model: the control plane remains in our managed environment but we can disable egress and enable customer-side keying (KMS).

Two action items for Novamed to confirm before we flip the switch:
1) Acceptance of our Private pilot amendment that limits usage to specific model IDs and excludes cross-tenant caching.
2) Confirmation of the technical contact who will accept the seeded environment and run the verification steps (we'll provide a runbook).

I will attach the SOC2 summary and a short runbook to this thread by EOD. If procurement needs a longer credit window (60 days instead of 45) we can escalate to leadership, but we prefer to keep initial sponsor to 45 days with a clear success checklist.

Karthik
Head of Applied Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; private-poc-runbook.md
From: Alex Tan <alex.tan@novamed.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@novamed.io, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 15:40:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Isolated/VPC pilot — need sponsored credits for air-gapped eval

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. Novamed accepts the proposed $12k credit package and 45-day window conditional on: 1) the SOC2 summary and runbook, 2) egress disabled for the environment, and 3) signed amendment. Procurement asked that we get DocuSign by Sep 5 to proceed with board approval on Sep 12.

I’ve attached the completed questionnaire with a few clarifying notes inline. Monica — can your team confirm the DocuSign and I’ll push to procurement to sign quickly.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — this pilot unlocks us for a 3-region purchase if successful.

— Alex

Attachments: novamed-security-questionnaire.pdf
